description: Closed vocabularies for the Foundry Script type-representation census. The C++ census validator (modules/foundry_script/tests/test_type_completeness_census.h) rejects any census file that uses a value outside these vocabularies.

policy_meanings.traverse: The operation must visit the child recursively; omitting the child from a traversal is the defect class the census exists to catch.
policy_meanings.preserve: The child is carried into the target unchanged without recursive inspection.
policy_meanings.substitute: The child is rebound against type arguments or receiver evidence before further use.
policy_meanings.project: The child is translated into another census representation.
policy_meanings.erase: The child is deliberately degraded; the information is not observable on that surface by design.
policy_meanings.not_applicable: The surface never sees this child; requires a rationale.

surface_meanings.analyzer: Static analysis only: parser and analyzer passes over source text.
surface_meanings.runtime_text: Text execution: the source-compiled path through the VM.
surface_meanings.runtime_bytecode: Bytecode execution: a script loaded from compiled .fsb and executed.
surface_meanings.bytecode_serialization: Compiled-bytecode export and reload: encode, decode, and loader validation.
surface_meanings.reflection: Reflective and proxy boundaries: PropertyInfo, Object.set/get, proxies, native/script crossings.
surface_meanings.editor_tools: Tools-only surface: diagnostics rendering, completion, hover, LSP, refactoring (TOOLS_ENABLED builds).

witness_build_configuration_meanings.editor: The doctest case is compiled only into an editor build, so a template build cannot bind it. A build that is not the declared configuration reports the claim as unconfirmed rather than as unresolved or as evidence.

coverage_status_meanings.covered: A witness observes this representation child on this surface, and the witness resolves: a registered doctest case, a tracked fixture, or exactly one cell of a registered rule family.
coverage_status_meanings.uncovered: Nothing observes this child on this surface yet. The entry names the workstream issue that owns closing it; a missing or unresolvable witness is never a pass.
coverage_status_meanings.unsupported: The configuration is genuinely unsupported. Allowed only when unsupported.json carries an entry for the same representation whose witness status is present.
coverage_status_meanings.quality_deferred: A witness exists but does not distinguish this child from its parent, so the observation is not yet evidence of coverage. The entry names the owning issue.
